status: AUTO-GENERATED · METHODOLOGICAL MEASUREMENT PRODUCT · NO ORDINAL RANKING · HUMAN INTERPRETATION REQUIRED
methodology: Operational Protocolometry measures observable evidence and pipeline properties: source availability, record traceability, scholarly metadata traceability and editorial source linkage. It does not rank institutions, people or states and does not convert technical availability into substantive verification.

doctrine.role: Methodological measurement layer connecting public-source discovery, academic search, traceability, editorial preparation and human correction.
principles: Human Authority remains the final institutional gate

measurement_profile.label: WPA Watch source availability
measurement_profile.limit: Technical feed availability only; it is not a judgment of source quality, credibility or institutional performance.

measurement_profile.label: Public-signal traceability completeness
measurement_profile.formula: records with title + public URL + source + publication date / watch records × 100
measurement_profile.limit: Completeness measures metadata presence, not factual truth.

measurement_profile.label: Scholarly discovery traceability pass rate
measurement_profile.formula: records with traceability_score ≥ 50 / scholarly discovery records × 100
measurement_profile.limit: Discovery metadata remains subject to human scholarly verification.

measurement_profile.label: Mean scholarly traceability score
measurement_profile.limit: This is a metadata traceability measure, not a scientific-quality score.

measurement_profile.label: Journal Watch source-link completeness
measurement_profile.formula: topics with title + source + source URL + verification notice / topics × 100
measurement_profile.limit: Editorial linkage does not imply acceptance, peer review or publication.

human_gate: Metrics can trigger review, correction and research prioritisation. They cannot autonomously create canonical rankings, scientific conclusions, peer-review decisions or official institutional judgments.
